mapper.sql: prr.participation_rate_rule_id as "participationRateRuleId", prr.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", emi.management_item_id as "managementItemId", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ee.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ee.element_code as "elementCode", ee.element_name as "elementName", emi.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", emi.management_item_name as "managementItemName", prr.researcher_count as "researcherCount", prr.participation_type as "participationType", (select max(dc.code_name) from detail_codes dc where dc.code_value = prr.participation_type and dc.status = 'ACTIVE' and dc.system_use_yn = 'Y' and (dc.group_id = 'PARTICIPATION_TYPE' or dc.group_id = 'RESEARCH_PARTICIPATION_TYPE')) as "participationTypeName", prr.distribution_rate as "distributionRate", prr.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", prr.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", prr.active_yn as "activeYn", prr.change_reason as "changeReason", prr.updated_by as "updatedBy", prr.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from participation_rate_rules prr inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = prr.rule_version_id inner join evaluation_management_items emi on emi.management_item_id = prr.management_item_id inner join evaluation_elements ee on ee.element_id = emi.element_id inner join evaluation_items ei on ei.item_id = ee.item_id inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id

where.if: and (prr.participation_type ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from detail_codes dc where dc.code_value = prr.participation_type and dc.status = 'ACTIVE' and dc.system_use_yn = 'Y' and (dc.group_id = 'PARTICIPATION_TYPE' or dc.group_id = 'RESEARCH_PARTICIPATION_TYPE') and dc.code_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') ) or emi.management_item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or emi.management_item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into participation_rate_rules (rule_version_id, management_item_id, researcher_count, participation_type, distribution_rate, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.managementItemId}, #{request.researcherCount}, #{request.participationType}, #{request.distributionRate}, #{request.effectiveStartDate}, #{request.effectiveEndDate}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, management_item_id, researcher_count, participation_type, effective_start_date, effective_end_date) do update set distribution_rate = EXCLUDED.distribution_rate, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
